title: T-shirt tourists
logline: Two tourists at Gully's in February. They're wearing the stick figure. Nobody in the strip mentions it.

panels.composition: Gully's, February, empty except for two TOURISTS at the counter in matching t-shirts: the stick figure with the rotor, printed. GULLY pouring. WOOD on the stool.

balloons.text: Two lattes. Is this the town from the—

image.prompt: two tourists in matching t-shirts printed with a crude stick figure wearing a helicopter rotor standing at a bait-and-espresso counter, a man pouring, another young man on the end stool with a dog, muddy digital flats
image.notes: The shirt: the parody's stick figure. Nobody in the strip says so.

panels.composition: Wood, drawing them. The shirt, in his drawing, is blank.

image.prompt: close-up of a drawing pad showing two tourists whose t-shirts have been left deliberately blank
image.notes: In Wood's drawing the shirts are blank. The strip refuses to draw the meme.

panels.composition: The tourists leaving. One turns at the door: the rotor on the back of the shirt too.

image.prompt: two tourists leaving a small shop, one turning at the door to reveal a helicopter rotor printed on the back of the shirt

panels.composition: Gully and Wood. The corkboard behind them. Gully has pinned something new to it: a printout of the parody's day one. Wood sees it. Says nothing. Gully says nothing. The dog sneezes.
props: corkboard with a printout of the parody

image.prompt: two young men in a quiet shop, one looking at a corkboard where a printout of a crude stick-figure comic has been newly pinned among the sketches, a dog sneezing, no words
image.notes: Gully pinned the parody. The strip records it and lets it go.

art.palette: limited; Sundays in watercolor, good now
art.paper: bristol; the browser; from 2008 coastal newsprint a week behind

notes: The stick figure on t-shirts. Wood draws the shirts blank. Gully pins the parody. The dog sneezes.
